title: UP Police SI Normalised Marks / Score Card 2026 – Out
organization: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
postName: UP Police Sub-Inspector (SI) Direct Recruitment – Scorecard / Normalised Marks
vacancyDetails: Normalised scorecards released for UP Police SI Direct Recruitment examination candidates
qualification: Graduation from a recognized university (as per UPPRPB SI notification)
ageLimit: As per UP Police SI notification
selectionProcess: Written Exam (Normalised Marks) → Physical Efficiency / PST → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Registration number & DOB/password for login; educational certificates for later stages
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppbpb.gov.in (UPPRPB official site)
2. Open SI Scorecard / Normalised Marks link
3. Login with registration credentials
4. Download scorecard (available till schedule end)
5. Keep printout for PET/PST and further stages
shortDescription: UPPRPB has released UP Police SI Scorecard 2026 with normalised marks. Candidates can download scores from official portal (window from 22 July 2026).
content:
The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has released normalised marks / scorecards for the UP Police Sub-Inspector Direct Recruitment examination.

Scorecards are available through candidate login on the official portal. As per reports, viewing window runs from 22 July 2026 (for a limited period such as until 21 August 2026 – check official notice).

What you get

  • Subject-wise / total normalised scores
  • Qualification status basis for next stage shortlisting

Use only official UPPRPB website. Normalisation is applied when exam is held in multiple shifts.
